The '''Epsi Collective''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Asturias]] and the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Epsi Nadir]], [[Old Barag/Legends|Old Barag]] and [[Vandelhelm/Legends|Vandelhelm]].
